title: Product Listing Page
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As** a user shopping in an online store,  
**I want** to view a list of products within a specific category or filtered selection,  
**so that** I can easily browse and compare items that match my interests.

‌

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:bread:</custom>  Breadcumbs

Are a global component that should be visible on all pages, but with the possibility of exceptions, such as the home page.

---

<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-2">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As** a user browsing an online shop,  
**I want** to see breadcrumb navigation on category and product pages,  
**so that** I can easily understand where I am and navigate back to higher-level categories.

---

### Requirements

Please note the annotations in Figma

| **Structure** Reflect the full navigation path (e.g., `Home > Women > Shoes > Sneakers`). If a page has multiple different parents, identify a canonical path to it in the site hierarchy and  show that path in  the breadcrumb trail. Each level (except the current page) is a clickable link. On PDP, the current category is clickable ([Details and Example here ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14145-361398&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-3">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14145-361398&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4)), product title is not part of the breadcrumb | [https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14145-125661&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14145-125661&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4)  |
| --- | --- |
| **Components used** [white secondary icon button small](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=122-2180&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4) [.internal/ \_navigation-menu-item mobile](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14145-16128&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4) |  |
| **Mobile Optimization** To save space on mobile devices, a "see more" button and only two categories are displayed: the current and the parent category. Clicking on the button shows the full navigation path [Example in Figma ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14145-361386&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-4">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14145-361386&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4) On small mobile screens it can happen that the breadcrumbs would also break in the shortened view. If this is the case, only show the current category. If the category name is still too long, truncate it. [Example in Figma ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14145-360978&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-5">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14145-360978&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4) | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=ee8c79c9-b7e0-4756-bf59-d0c0a3f795a0&&collection=&height=484&occurrenceKey=null&width=426&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=c5c06131-93e9-49a0-af42-37677cc8b1cf&&collection=&height=487&occurrenceKey=null&width=385&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |
| **Desktop** Display full navigation path Hover over Breadcrumb item opens dropdown with sub categories Click on Breadcrumb item opens the corresponding page [Example in Figma ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14145-361805&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-6">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14145-361805&t=aARHqzA1E7J0jGbx-4) | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=054cc16f-90ca-4921-bf1f-c3aebe101b4e&&collection=&height=546&occurrenceKey=null&width=1302&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |
| **Localization** Breadcrumb labels adapt to the selected language and locale (Right-to-left layout support for RTL languages (e.g., Arabic, Hebrew).) |  |
| **Dynamic Rendering** Generate dynamically based on the page's taxonomy and hierarchy. Support deep linking and SEO-friendly URLs. |  |

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-9">:shopping_cart:</custom>  Category Header / basic

The basic variant of the page header for product lists aka categories. This contains not only the page title (category title), but also space for a short SEO text and an in-page navigation.

---

<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-10">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As** a user browsing a category page on an online store,  
**I want** to see a clear category title, relevant navigation links, and visually engaging styling,  
**so that** I can understand what section I'm in, quickly access related subcategories, and enjoy a consistent, themed shopping experience.

---

### Requirements

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14605-394163&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14605-394163&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4) 

| **Title and SEO Text** **Category Title** Displayed as an `<h1>` element for accessibility and SEO. Pulled dynamically based on the current category context. **Optional SEO Text** Rich text block displayed directly under the `<h1>`. Supports basic formatting (bold, italic, links). Editable per locale via CMS. | [Example in Figma ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14605-393664&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-11">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14605-393664&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=5544520b-92c7-45a8-b757-19c36de22828&&collection=&height=488&occurrenceKey=null&width=437&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=55f764f2-dd8b-4459-a7e4-8dfc11624186&&collection=&height=435&occurrenceKey=null&width=431&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |
| --- | --- |
| **In-Page Navigation Slider** **Category Nodes Slider** Uses Inpage Navigation / Basic, / Big and / Compact Slider, depending on the Theme Those are presets and can be changed by the user. Either globally or only for a specific category. Each node is a clickable button or card linking to a subcategory page. **Styling Flexibility** Ability to apply different visual styles to the category nodes in the chosen slider Styles are controlled via theme or design tokens per default A user can also decide to show no category nodes at all (can be the case with very small stores that have no further subcategories) | [Examples in Figma ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14605-399172&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-12">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14605-399172&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=0fa7e287-f5ed-4fcf-b9dd-bd956a9ed98f&&collection=&height=590&occurrenceKey=null&width=774&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |
| **Category Navigation**  If the last subcategory is reached and there are no further subcategories: Show the siblings of this category. So if this is category lvl 3, then all other lvl 3 category nodes in this tree. Highlight the current category in the category nodes slider (annotation in figma) | [Example in Figma ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14606-400379&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-13">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14606-400379&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=db529141-6a3d-42f9-a905-1d602fcaf0d5&&collection=&height=636&occurrenceKey=null&width=308&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |
| **Background & Theming** **Background Customization** Background color of the header section can be set per category or theme. Initially set by theme variable **theme / category header / basic / bg-color** Supports pale colors for MVP (color step 3) **Theming Support** Component supports multiple visual themes Each theme may define: A unique category node slider layout/style. Custom spacing, fonts, and iconography. Background and border settings. | [Some Design Examples in use ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14601-393138&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-14">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14601-393138&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4) [Some header examples in Figma ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14605-399172&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-15">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14605-399172&t=2VdYnJXHqVZcfASo-4) |
| **Responsive Design** Fully responsive behavior with mobile-first implementation. Slider supports touch gestures and swipe interactions. |  |
| **Accessibility & Performance** WCAG 2.1 AA compliant: Proper ARIA roles for slider and nav elements. Keyboard navigability for all interactive components. Lazy-loading support for images and slider content. Fast render times and optimized for Core Web Vitals. |  |

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-16">:diamond_shape_with_a_dot_inside:</custom> Product Grid

---

<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-17">:person_with_crown:</custom> **User Story**

**As a** user browsing a product listing page,  
**I want** to view products in a clear, visually organized grid layout,  
**So that** I can easily compare options and find items that interest me without having to scroll through disorganized content.

---

### Requirements

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14795-155216&t=D15GraY4m5o14KTa-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14795-155216&t=D15GraY4m5o14KTa-4) 

Please note the annotations in Figma

| Display amount of products, defined by lazy loading rules Responsive Layout Possibility to display other content in [**content slots**](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14795-155027&t=QALGOSrjTweT4ylU-4) or directly [**in the grid**](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14795-155026&t=QALGOSrjTweT4ylU-4). see [design example here](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=14452-164025&t=QALGOSrjTweT4ylU-4) Clicking on a product takes the user to its detailed product page. The grid updates dynamically when filters or sorting options are applied. The layout adjusts responsively for different screen sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile). | content slot example: ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=3cb1cf69-c7a2-48ec-b086-8663c013bc8f&&collection=&height=277&occurrenceKey=null&width=206&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) content in grid exapmle: ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=eec88edd-69c5-4fa4-8aaa-d1a391067886&&collection=&height=515&occurrenceKey=null&width=208&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)   |
| --- | --- |
| **Accessibility Requirements:** Each product item must be navigable via keyboard (e.g., using Tab and Enter keys). Product images must include descriptive `alt` text. Use semantic HTML (e.g., `<ul>`/`<li>`, `<section>`, `<article>`) to structure the grid. ARIA roles or landmarks must be used appropriately (e.g., `role="list"` for the grid and `role="listitem"` for each product card). Focus indicators must be visible and clearly styled for interactive elements. Screen readers should announce product titles and prices when focused on a product card. |  |

## PLP Empty State

Is used in the event that a user arrives at an empty list. For example, if they have used an old link to a pre-filtered list and the products are already sold out or no longer in the shop. The aim is to keep the user in the flow and active by using friendly wording and appropriate components, i.e. to avoid a dead end.

---

<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-18">:person_with_crown:</custom> User story

**As a** user,  
**I want** to see a helpful and informative empty state screen when there are no products in the product list,  
**So that** I understand why the list is empty and what actions I can take next.

## Requirements

| **Visual Design & Layout** The empty state screen should appear only when the product list contains **zero items**. It should occupy the **main content area** where products are normally listed. Include a **friendly illustration or icon** that represents an empty product list. Include **concise messaging** that communicates the state clearly. | [https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15272-139031&t=KBarTgaq8f4rSg2p-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15272-139031&t=KBarTgaq8f4rSg2p-4) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=2b2996a8-9860-4940-ab36-7e725696c050&&collection=&height=369&occurrenceKey=null&width=208&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |
| --- | --- |
| **Best Practice Page Content** To keep the user in action, it is advisable to display additional content outside the message: Recommendation Slider Top Categories Newly arrived products Top Brands etc. Another option would be to display products as a product grid from another category or the supercategory | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=8f8e5b86-51d3-43d1-9237-57077b770c1b&&collection=&height=726&occurrenceKey=null&width=478&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |
| **Empty State Message Component** has 3 variants: with icon with image just text user can change the icon or emoji as they like image recommendation is with transparent background default color is theme/colors/grey 3, but user can change that if he wants can change text alignment | [design in figma ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15272-139050&t=KBarTgaq8f4rSg2p-4)<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-19">:link:</custom>[ ](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=15272-139050&t=KBarTgaq8f4rSg2p-4) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=c56e1b61-ba7e-4286-a57b-623e0ce895e7&&collection=&height=494&occurrenceKey=null&width=203&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |

enrichedData.purpose: Enables shoppers to browse and compare products within categories through an organized listing page with navigation, filtering, and infinite scroll capabilities
useCases: Display products in a responsive grid layout with lazy loading
Show breadcrumb navigation reflecting the full category path
Provide mobile-optimized breadcrumbs with expandable navigation
Implement load more functionality with progress indication
Display category header with title, SEO text, and subcategory navigation
Show in-page category node sliders for quick subcategory access
Handle empty state with helpful messaging and alternative content
Support keyboard navigation and screen reader accessibility for product grids
Enable content slots within the product grid for promotional content
